name: Reviling
overview: The topic of reviling is vividly illustrated in the crucifixion narrative of Jesus, where He is subjected to intense verbal abuse and mockery by passersby, religious leaders, and even the criminals crucified alongside Him. These verses reveal the depth of scorn Jesus endured, as His accusers challenged His divine identity and power, sarcastically urging Him to save Himself if He truly was the Son of God. This harsh treatment underscores the rejection and suffering Christ willingly bore, fulfilling His role as the Savior despite unjust reviling.
